CLM-MAT-0443.statement: Molecular dynamics simulations of the bulk model with ensemble averaging yield a band gap blue shift of 12 meV at 0.5% tensile strain.

extra_quotes: Here, we use MD simulations based on machine-learned force fields trained on-the-fly on first-principles DFT calculations to model epitaxially strained MAPbI3 at 300 K.

All calculations are performed using the Vienna Ab-initio Simulation Package (VASP) [46– 48]. We use the strongly constrained and appropriately normed (SCAN) meta-generalized gradient approximation [49] in the MD simulations
All MD simulations are performed at 300 K using the Langevin thermostat in an N pT ensemble.

First, we neglect spin-orbit coupling and many-body corrections, which can modify the strain dependence of the band gap, particularly through the Pb-p-derived conduction band. Second, the 2 × 2 × 2 supercell limits the configurational averaging of band gaps, and larger supercells may change the magnitude of the shift. Third, our unstrained reference, defined by c/a = 1.009, may not correspond exactly to the state of the reference films in experiment.
